article_content: What you need to know: Google's smart home is stepping into generative AI with a new 'help me script' feature for Google Home's script editor. This AI-driven tool makes it easier to build advanced automations, even without coding experience. According to Google's latest blog post, the 'help me script' feature generates code for routines such as turning on lights when you get out of bed or announcing a delivery. You simply copy and paste the output into the script editor. Google notes that the feature is powered by a language model (though unspecified) and continues to learn, producing more accurate scripts every day. It will appear in Google Home's web app Public Preview later this year.

article_content: On Tuesday, the Republican-led House voted 249-163 to publicly criticize President Barack Obama for failing to provide the required 30-day congressional notice before trading five Taliban prisoners from Guantanamo Bay for Army Sergeant Bowe Bergdahl in May. In the final count, 22 Democrats, many facing difficult campaigns, joined Republicans in supporting the nonbinding resolution. Speaker John Boehner argued that releasing 'five top Taliban commanders' made the United States less secure, echoing concerns that Obama had violated a federal law mandating congressional notification 30 days prior to any detainee transfer from Guantanamo. A recent Government Accountability Office analysis similarly concluded the administration had not complied with the law. Bergdahl was captured after disappearing from his outpost in eastern Afghanistan on June 30, 2009, and the exchange allowed the soldier to return safely to U.S. soil. Under the deal, the five Taliban members are required to remain in Qatar for one year. Both Republican and Democratic lawmakers expressed anger that Congress received no official notice, although as many as 80 to 90 officials within the government reportedly knew of the plan. Administration representatives cited multiple justifications for the secrecy, including Bergdahl's declining health and fears that news of the impending swap might leak, confounding efforts to secure his release. President Obama also contended that his constitutional authority as commander in chief took precedence over the statute in question. During the House debate, Rep. Adam Smith from Washington acknowledged Obama should have informed Congress but dismissed the resolution as a partisan tactic against a Democratic president, recalling that Republican President George W. Bush had also acted without congressional approval on various post-9/11 measures. Some members of Congress labeled Bergdahl a deserter and insisted the United States made a poor deal, fearing that the high-ranking Taliban officials could soon rejoin the conflict in Afghanistan. However, military leaders, including the Joint Chiefs of Staff, supported bringing Bergdahl home under the longstanding promise never to leave service members behind. Bergdahl is currently carrying out administrative duties at Fort Sam Houston in San Antonio while a formal inquiry examines circumstances surrounding his disappearance. The House resolution, which also voiced relief for Bergdahl's safe return, emerged just as Obama was trying to build support for measures against the Islamic State threat in the Middle East, prompting some legislators to question the timing of the vote.

article_content: Partygoers have begun dressing in Halloween costumes that imitate fighters from the Islamic State (ISIS), sparking outrage over trivializing global horrors. Social media is filled with photos showing individuals in ISIS-style outfits, just weeks after the terrorist group beheaded four Western hostages in Iraq and Syria. Some people pose with fake machetes or severed heads, mimicking brutal executions. The group routinely beheads opponents and often shares horrific images of members posing with victims. One photo posted on a Twitter account by someone called Baghdadi Al-Rolexi read: 'Another victory!! So many converted ISIS recruits at Halloween parties. I tell you, best strategy girls and booze!' This wave of upsetting costumes comes on the heels of accusations that businesses are profiting from the Ebola crisis by selling so-called 'sexy nurse' containment outfits, despite the death toll approaching 5,000. One Twitter user shared photos of partygoers wearing face masks and black gowns, brandishing fake weapons, while another Instagram user wrote about needing an escape from everyday hardships, using hashtags like #ISIS and #TERRORIST. Four women in revealing black outfits pulled mock-gun poses, while other images showed individuals wearing black masks and toting replica rifles, celebrating these costumes under the claim of harmless fun. Another Twitter post, captioned 'Where's the Halloween parties... Isis will be there,' showed militants in similar ISIS-inspired attire. In another image, an attendee wearing a ninja outfit retitled as a jihadist costume was shared by Heidi Harris, who also mentioned the popularity of Ebola suits. Recently, ISIS beheaded U.S. journalist James Foley, British aid worker David Haines, British taxi driver Alan Henning, and American journalist Steven Sotloff. Some Halloween costumes featured a fake severed head and machete, referencing these beheadings. Ebola-themed costumes have also appeared online, labeled as a 'sexy Ebola containment suit,' with marketing descriptions that mock the seriousness of the outbreak. Bars and online stores faced criticism for hosting Ebola-themed parties or selling outfits that mimic protective gear from deadly disease zones. Fancy dress suppliers came under further fire for selling items labeled 'skitzo' or 'psycho ward,' eliciting condemnation from political figures like Liberal Democrat Care and Support Minister Norman Lamb, who argued these costumes stigmatize mental health conditions.

article_content: Vance McAllister, a newcomer to politics who gained encouragement from 'Duck Dynasty' star Phil Robertson, secured a spot in the U.S. House for Louisiana's 5th Congressional District on Saturday evening. His victory came by a 60-percent-to-40-percent margin over State Senator Neil Riser, a Tea Party favorite who had been considered the establishment frontrunner. McAllister contributed a significant amount of his own funds to the campaign and presented himself as a more balanced Republican alternative. While Riser remained adamant in criticizing President Obama's policies, McAllister focused on overcoming the polarized standstill in Washington. He emphasized that endless attempts to repeal the President's health care law did little to solve real problems. The 5th District seat opened when Republican Rodney Alexander stepped down to join Governor Bobby Jindal's administration. Although the race was often framed as Tea Party versus establishment, Riser represented both elements, spotlighting his experience and pledging strong opposition to Obama. In contrast, McAllister took pride in being an outsider. His endorsement from Phil Robertson underscored that he was not part of traditional politics. Riser's background as a business owner in the funeral industry offered a track record of legislative work, such as helping pass a constitutional amendment strengthening gun rights. Still, McAllister argued that respecting the presidency while seeking ways to improve existing laws was a more productive tactic. McAllister ultimately proved that a moderate angle paired with a high-profile endorsement could resonate with voters in the largely rural and poverty-stricken district. Despite investing at least $800,000 of his own money, he did not adopt the 'burn it all down' rhetoric associated with some GOP contenders elsewhere. Instead, he urged Republicans to be both firm in principle yet open to respectful collaboration. 'Duck Dynasty,' a reality show centered on the Robertson family business Duck Commander, plays a key cultural role in West Monroe, Louisiana. The show's broad popularity, combined with Robertson's public support, likely boosted McAllister's appeal among constituents looking for a fresh perspective in Congress.

Zvítězil poměrem 60 procent ku 40 procentům nad senátorem Neilem Riserem z Louisiany, který byl oblíbený mezi stoupenci hnutí Tea Party a považován za kandidáta tradiční republikánské části. McAllister do kampaně vložil výrazné množství vlastních prostředků a prezentoval se jako umírněná republikánská alternativa. Zatímco Riser ostře kritizoval politiku prezidenta Obamy, McAllister se zaměřil na prolomení patu ve Washingtonu. Zdůrazňoval, že nekonečné pokusy o zrušení prezidentova zdravotnického zákona příliš nepomáhají k řešení reálných problémů. Křeslo v 5. okrsku se uvolnilo poté, co republikán Rodney Alexander odstoupil, aby se připojil k administrativě guvernéra Bobbyho Jindala. Přestože byl tento souboj často líčen jako střet Tea Party a tradičního establishmentu, Riser představoval oba proudy a zdůrazňoval své zkušenosti v boji proti Obamovi. Naopak McAllister vyzdvihoval svou roli outsidera. Podpora Phila Robertsona dokazovala, že není součástí zaběhnutých politických struktur. Riser, podnikající ve funeralnictví, se prezentoval jako zkušený zákonodárce, který například pomáhal prosadit ústavní dodatek posilující práva na držení zbraní. McAllister ovšem prosazoval také úctu k postu prezidenta a hledání možností, jak zdokonalovat stávající legislativu. Nakonec McAllister názorně předvedl, že umírněný přístup a známé veřejné doporučení dokážou oslovit voliče v převážně venkovském a chudobou ohroženém okrsku. Ačkoli do voleb investoval nejméně 800 000 dolarů z vlastních zdrojů, odmítl radikální rétoriku, která se někdy objevuje mezi republikánskými kandidáty. Místo toho GOP vybízel k důsledným principům a současně k vzájemnému respektu. 'Duck Dynasty' je populární reality pořad zachycující rodinu Robertsonových a jejich společnost Duck Commander ve městě West Monroe v Louisianě. Široká popularita pořadu a Robertsonova veřejná podpora pravděpodobně zvýšily McAllisterovu přitažlivost pro voliče hledající nový směr v Kongresu.

article_content: It was a traditional yet rather miserable start to the bank holiday weekend. Yesterday, much of the UK saw rain and cold temperatures, with the Met Office indicating this spring may be the coldest for over 30 years. Unsettled weather looks likely to affect Bank Holiday Monday and continue into next week, dampening the summer half-term break for schoolchildren. Temperatures dipped as low as 7C (45F) yesterday, prompting severe weather warnings in parts of the country. Traffic was already building on the A14 near a rainy Cambridge as the bank holiday getaway began. Many travelers braved the conditions, hoping the weather would clear. Meanwhile, high winds blew from the South West up to Yorkshire, making already chilly temperatures feel even colder. The Met Office believes this spring will be the coldest since 1979, with a mean UK temperature of around 6.1C (43F), well below the long-term average of 7.7C (46F). According to MeteoGroup forecaster John Lee, a low-pressure system moving from the North Sea is bringing showers and keeping skies cloudy, accompanied by brisk winds in the South and South East. Despite all this, Britons remained determined to enjoy the long weekend. There is some reason for optimism. Forecasters said conditions could improve over the weekend. Today, many parts of the country will see sunny intervals with temperatures around 14C (57F) and highs of 18C (64F) in London. Met Office spokesperson Sarah Holland mentioned the chance of morning showers in the South East but noted that most areas will remain dry and sunny, with temperatures near 17C (63F) in London. Tomorrow might see a cold start and possible grass frost, but it should warm up quickly, reaching 17C or 18C. Even Scotland, which recently saw snowfall, can look forward to clear skies and sunshine this bank holiday, according to forecasters. Monday could bring temperatures of up to 20C (68F) in parts of East Anglia and Kent, though cloud and rain are expected to arrive later from the west. Over the half-term break, conditions are expected to remain mixed, featuring heavy showers and sunny spells. Retailers are preparing for both outcomes, stocking barbecue supplies and extra pairs of wellies for those braving wet weather. Despite the gloom, orchard blossoms have finally arrived in places like Somerset and Dorset, two weeks later than usual. Growers remain optimistic that the larger blooms could yield a plentiful apple harvest this year, especially if warmer weather arrives soon. In more unusual spring news, a reindeer calf was born during a snowstorm in the Cairngorms, stepping out onto wintry ground instead of lush spring grass. Meanwhile, flamingos in Lancashire delayed laying eggs due to the cold but have now started hatching chicks. Overall, the late May bank holiday weekend began on a chilly and damp note, but forecasters promise some respite, with drier and sunnier conditions in the coming days. Many remain hopeful that this extended break will turn out to be more enjoyable than initially feared.

Zítra může být ráno chladno a může se objevit přízemní mráz, ale jakmile vyjde slunce, rychle se oteplí až na 17 nebo 18 °C. I Skotsko, které nedávno zaznamenalo sněžení, se podle meteorologů může těšit na jasnou oblohu a slunečné počasí během prodlouženého víkendu. V pondělí mohou teploty ve Východní Anglii a Kentu dosáhnout až 20 °C, i když později během dne se od západu očekává oblačnost a déšť. Během pololetních prázdnin v příštím týdnu se očekává proměnlivé počasí s vydatnými přeháňkami a slunečnými intervaly. Prodejci se připravují na obě varianty, nakupují zásoby určené na grilování a také další páry holínek pro případ deštivého počasí. Navzdory pochmurnému ránu se v místech jako Somerset a Dorset konečně objevily květy ovocných sadů, asi o dva týdny později, než je obvyklé. Pěstitelé zůstávají optimističtí, že větší květy by mohly přinést bohatou úrodu jablek, zejména pokud brzy dorazí teplejší počasí. Ve zvláštní jarní zprávě se v Cairngorms během sněhové bouře narodilo mládě soba, které místo po bujné jarní trávě šlapalo po zasněžené zemi. Mezitím plameňáci v Lancashire odložili kladení vajec kvůli chladu, ale nyní jim začínají líhnout mláďata. Celkově začal pozdní květnový víkend chladně a deštivě, ale meteorologové slibují určitou úlevu v podobě sušších a slunečnějších dnů. Mnozí doufají, že se tento prodloužený víkend vydaří lépe, než se původně obávali.
